human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Extend the existing source-neutral EvidenceEvent/EvidencePackage model just enough to express package provenance, artifact refs, exporter metadata, and coverage without adding EverRun-specific fields. Preserve compatibility with current v1.5 fixtures. Dependency: 8004.document-decision-domains.
human_pressure.why_now: The existing model is intentionally small; dogfood import needs stricter provenance while existing Clarify/evidence packages must keep working.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: No change to runtime policy behavior.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Add backwards-compatible provenance fields and strict validation for runtime evidence package v1.
red_lines: No change to runtime policy behavior.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8004.document-decision-domains. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Existing package ingestion semantics stay compatible.
failure_semantics: Invalid required metadata fails validation; optional metadata absence remains valid for older schema versions.

steps.title: Add typed optional provenance structures
details: Do not add planner/coder/pack as mandatory core concepts.

steps.title: Add package metadata structures
details: Exporter version/source digest/coverage may remain metadata but validate documented shape when present.

acceptance: Existing v1.5 evidence package loader tests remain green.
New provenance shape supports source pointers and artifact references without EverRun-specific mandatory fields.
Malformed required v1 provenance/identity is rejected deterministically.

must_check: Backward compatibility with current evidence fixtures.
reject_if: EverRun-specific fields become mandatory core fields.
Current evidence package fixture breaks without a versioned migration reason.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: New contract tests plus existing loader compatibility tests.
